title: Best way to see the Gothic Quarter
text: I did a tour of the Gothic quarter and it was amazing. Tati, our guide, was not only informative but also very cheerful which was contagious. She made learning about history fun!!
author: 708effies

title: Individual and informative
text: A very informative tour, where you really learned much more than what is in normal guidebooks. A very friendly guide and a small group of interested people. I have already booked another tour with this provider.

title: Fantastic tour
text: Fantastic tour with an exceptional guide, Elena. She was engaging and a great storyteller. The group had about 8 people, which was perfect. This was one of the best group tours I have done. Highly recommend

title: Excellent Tour with Runner Beans in Barcelona!
text: Runner Beans Tours is amazing! Elena our guide was excellent! She not  explained the history and knew every street in Gothic quarters and its significance! Highly recommend Runner Beans Tours!
author: skindlo

title: Interesting, informative and fun.
text: Tati took us on a most enjoyable and informative walk through the Gothic Quarter. She spoke well, giving plenty of facts but never overloading us. Despite being gently spoken we were able to hear every word she said and she interacted well with the guests. I was particularly impressed that, when some went missing, she knew exactly who to wait for. I would thoroughly recommend the tour.
author: Bridget027

title: Fascinating!
text: Fantastic walking tour through El Gòtic. Lisa was very knowledgeable and engaging, and led us through less-well known places in the neighborhood. We learned a lot about the history of Catalunya through the centuries. Totally worth it!
